name: code-agent
context: Agents that write and execute code to accomplish tasks, using the execution results as observations that ground subsequent reasoning. The agent produces code (not free-form text) as its primary action, executes it in a sandbox, and reads the output as an observation. Code is the agent's main tool — it can perform calculations, interact with filesystems, call APIs, and orchestrate sub-processes. This pattern is the foundation of autonomous coding agents like SWE-Agent, Devin, and Claude Code's internal tool-use model.
benefits: Code provides precise, executable instructions — no parsing ambiguity
Execution results are deterministic ground-truth observations
Agents can build on prior code outputs without prompt re-entry
Sandboxed execution provides safety boundaries for dangerous operations
tradeoffs: Requires a reliable code execution environment
Code generation quality depends heavily on the model's coding capability
Debugging failed code requires the agent to interpret error messages
Execution environment state can drift across runs
use_cases: Autonomous bug fixing with test-driven feedback
Data analysis scripts over large datasets
Automated report generation with live data computation
avoid_when: No code execution environment is available
Tasks are purely conversational without computational elements
Environments where code execution is prohibited
anti_patterns: Trusting code output without validating it
No sandboxing — executing code in the production environment
Accumulating execution state without resetting between tasks
design_principles: Always sandbox code execution — never in the production environment
Treat execution errors as observations, not failures
Code should be self-contained and stateless where possible
best_practices: Use a fresh sandbox for each code execution to avoid state pollution
Set resource limits (CPU, memory, time) on code execution
Parse and validate code output programmatically before proceeding
references: Yang et al., SWE-Agent: Agentic LLM for Software Engineering, 2024 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15793
